frame.treatment: Continuous even flat golden-yellow frame, no bevel or shadow

factual_anchors: This is an original imaginary editorial concept, not a named real location or an archival photograph
Only the scene and exact text specified for this example
allowed_changes: Compose the new original scene and adjust crop/light to achieve the specified cover
Optically refine text within its designated zone while retaining exact characters
forbidden_changes: Recognizable famous landmarks or named real buildings
People, vehicles, flags or animals unless explicitly requested
Extra text, fake captions, barcodes, dates, numbers, logos
Detached rectangular title panels or decorative geometric mountains
review_checks: One immediate visual focus at 200px wide
Exact Chinese characters and intended line order
Source image retains tangible photographic depth/material
Masthead and headline have different functions and strong local contrast
No accidental collision of text and important subject features
content_promise: 以峰体和前后山脊的关系呈现尺度，示范纵深与克制的侧置标题。

direction.why_this_image: A clear peak silhouette on the right and a shadowed foreground on the left offer separate image and headline centers.
direction.why_rejected: It would obscure the defining ridge and compete with the mountain silhouette.

art_direction.subject: An original imagined high mountain range at first light, angular snow-capped summit on the right, no claim to depict any named peak.
art_direction.camera: Distant telephoto landscape, layered compressed ridges, full vertical sense without a fake fisheye mountain.
art_direction.subject_scale: Main peak on right-middle occupies roughly half image height; upper 25% provides calm deep-blue sky.
art_direction.foreground: Dark slate-blue rock ridge on lower left with crisp texture, left negative field for title.
art_direction.middle_ground: One dominant right-hand snow summit touched by pale gold morning light; important ridge remains fully visible.
art_direction.background: Two softer blue mountain layers behind, clear restrained sky with no giant moon or decorative stars.
art_direction.eye_path: White masthead -> gold-lit peak on right -> descending ridge -> restrained title on left shadow.
art_direction.light: First sunlight catches only upper snow and rock, cold blue shadows retain detail.
art_direction.palette: Slate blue, ice white, tiny warm gold highlights; warm ivory title and continuous muted gold outer frame.
art_direction.texture: Photorealistic snow/rock structure and fine atmospheric separation, documentary-style tonal restraint.

text.font_character: Large distinctive Chinese Song/Mincho serif, confident broad strokes, fine stroke contrast, optically spaced; original masthead occupies roughly two thirds of width.
text.contrast_plan: White masthead against quiet deep blue upper sky.

text.font_character: Strong ivory Song serif, two lines offset along the shadow ridge, clear full Chinese characters.
text.contrast_plan: Keep whole title in uniform deep-blue foreground shadow; avoid the snowy summit.
